issues.where: left edge across the lower third (also B-05)
issues.what: The portrait wake push clips the far headlamp and nose at the left edge while the skyline still dominates above. The nearly head-on settle does not use the narrow frame to reveal the car's side.
issues.fix: Reblock the portrait push on a more oblique front three-quarter axis, and track the nose so both lamps hold deliberate edge clearance at the settle.

issues.where: wheel in the center-right, throughout the beat
issues.what: The very low, grazing perspective foreshortens the front wheel into a narrow ellipse; the early compositions also give the headlamp a competing foreground position. The rim face and brake hardware never become the clear subject of the macro.
issues.fix: Move closer to the wheel axis and raise to roughly hub height; use a tighter field of view led by the rim and arch rather than the bumper.

issues.where: center of the paint move, also set-B-07.png
issues.what: The glide reads as a windshield-and-side-mirror insert. The painted hood sits along the lower edge while the mirror and the building occupy the portrait center.
issues.fix: Move the glide lower and closer to the panel, letting a painted crease and a broad run of clearcoat carry the frame; keep the mirror peripheral.

issues.where: rear silhouette through B-19 to B-21
issues.what: Portrait ignition flattens to an almost direct rear elevation, hiding the flank and mirroring the nose-on portrait wake instead of giving the low rear three-quarter its own depth.
issues.fix: Keep the low camera but move off the rear centerline, preserving both exhaust outlets and a clear view down one flank as the move settles.
